note: NIDA's own news (12 December 2025 and 13 November 2024, read 2026-11-03): the regulations under the Registration and Identification of Persons Act (No. 11) were amended on 21 February 2023 so that a citizen's national ID has no expiry (resident foreigners and refugees still renew), so the card is kept as never expiring and no renewal is modelled. One applies and gives biometrics at NIDA's district registration office and collects the card there on its receipt (NIDA's citizen registration page). That the first card is free still stands on The Citizen (11 June 2022: free since 2013); NIDA charges TZS 20,000 to change particulars (not modelled). The age from which it is issued and the time weren't found.

sources.title: The Citizen (Tanzania), Tanzanians to part with Sh20,000 for renewal of national IDs (11 June 2022)
sources.said: As it has emerged, citizens will have to pay Sh20,000 each when renewing the National IDs, unlike the past when they were issued free of charge.

sources.title: The Citizen (Tanzania), Tanzania removes expiration date on national IDs (22 February 2023)
sources.said: Tanzania's national identity cards are set to last indefinitely after the government announced the removal of the expiration date.

sources.title: NIDA, Vitambulisho vya Raia Havina Mwisho wa Matumizi (Citizens' IDs have no expiry) (12 December 2025)
sources.said: “Serikali kupitia Wizara ya Mambo ya Ndani ya Nchi (MOHA), imeshaondoa ukomo wa matumizi ya Kitambulisho cha Taifa hivyo wananchi waendelee kutumia vitambulisho vyao pindi wanapohitaji huduma za kijamii na kiuchumi katika taasisi za Serikali na binafsi.” ... kuamua Kanuni za Sheria Na. 11 ya Usajili na Utambuzi wa Watu kufanyiwa marekebisho Februari 21, 2023 na kutoa kibali kwa Raia wa Tanzania kuendelea kutumia Vitambulisho vya Taifa bila ukomo. ... Ikumbukwe tarehe ya ukomo wa matumizi ya vitambulisho hauwahusu wageni wakaazi na wakimbizi

sources.title: NIDA, Kamati ya Kudumu ya Bunge ya Bajeti Yaahidi Ushirikiano kwa NIDA (13 November 2024)
sources.said: Amebainisha kuwa Serikali kupitia Wizara ya Mambo ya Ndani ya Nchi imefanya marekebisho ya Kanuni za Sheria ya Usajili na Utambui wa Watu za mwaka 2014 kwa kuondoa ukomo wa muda wa matumizi ya vitambulisho kwa raia

sources.title: NIDA, Usajili na Utambuzi wa Raia (citizen registration)
sources.said: Wasilisha fomu yako ya maombi kwenye Ofisi ya Usajili ya NIDA wilaya unakoishi kwa ajili ya kuchukuliwa alama za kibaiolojia ... Mwombaji anatakiwa kufika katika ofisi ya usajili katika wilaya husika ... ili kupatiwa kitambulisho chake kwa kuzingatia kuja na risiti maalumu aliyopatiwa na NIDA
